data.explanation: This is a routine bill for the mandatory German public broadcasting fee (Rundfunkbeitrag), which every household must pay regardless of whether they own a TV or radio. The amount of 55.08 € covers three months (18.36 €/month) and is due on 15.11.2026. Pay it by bank transfer to the IBAN given, using your Beitragsnummer as the payment reference, or set up a direct debit (SEPA-Lastschrift) so you don't have to remember future payments. If you receive certain social benefits (e.g. BAföG) you may be able to apply for an exemption. The letter itself warns that it will never ask for payment to a foreign account or threaten immediate seizure of assets — treat any such demand as fraudulent.
